definitions.explanation: An organized event where products, artworks, or other items are displayed for viewing by the public or by industry professionals.

examples.japanese: {展示会|てんじかい}に{行|い}く。
{来週|らいしゅう}、{東京|とうきょう}で{自動車|じどうしゃ}の{展示会|てんじかい}が{開|ひら}かれる。
examples.english: Next week, an automobile exhibition will be held in Tokyo.

examples.japanese: この{展示会|てんじかい}には{毎年|まいとし}{世界中|せかいじゅう}から{多|おお}くの{企業|きぎょう}が{出展|しゅってん}している。
examples.english: Many companies from around the world exhibit at this trade show every year.

notes:
A compound of {展示|てんじ} (display/exhibition) + {会|かい} (event/meeting). Refers to organized events where products, artworks, technology, etc. are put on display. Can range from art shows to large-scale trade fairs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {展示会|てんじかい}を{開|ひら}く: to hold an exhibition
- {展示会|てんじかい}に{出展|しゅってん}する: to exhibit at a trade show
- {展示会|てんじかい}{会場|かいじょう}: exhibition venue
- {合同|ごうどう}{展示会|てんじかい}: joint exhibition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {展覧会|てんらんかい}: exhibition — primarily for art and cultural works
- {博覧会|はくらんかい}: exposition/fair — larger scale, often international
- {見本市|みほんいち}: trade fair — specifically for commercial/industry displays
